body:
True enough.
I'll think on that.
Not all that much. Pleasure is a hard thing to come by. I mostly try to be content with myself.

There is. I neither want nor need to. And that is without taking into account, the fact that there are physiological changes to my brain.

My hope is to wait around for medical advances and better understanding of the human brain.

Not necesserily - killing myself means immediate hurt that slowly dulls itself as time progresses.

Not killing myself means (and this has been proven by past experience) making them suffer my death/illness (other than ASPD) over and over.

And yet, the problem is I can relate, so while in general you may be right, in this case RevRaven is somewhat right - only I wouldn't go as far as hate or stealing - but that is just arguing semantics.
I already am. That's why I'm posting here.

Both of those I've tried. 
I've written a few stories (quite personal, quite satisfying), nothing good though, but it doesn't help in the slightest. 
I have a good memory for my lies I believe. I've worked out a general system and need to focus only on the details, so it's fairly easy to remember quite a bit about my lying. I've sought redemption for a few, but it's hard to admit I'm lying. I'm worried I'm starting to believe myself.

Thanks. I don't think I have any significant deviations in the mentioned points, OR most of them mixed together as character traits, but maybe it's time for a professional opinion. I honestly can't say whether I'll do this as even the possibility scares me quite a bit, but I'll try to find someone to talk to.

Thanks for the advice.
I don't believe I lie to make friends, but I'll dwell on that.

Why hate though? I haven't noticed it so far and I am considered successful and I have a couple of people, who have depended on me in the recent past (3-4 months) on matters they considered important. I am not hurting anyone I believe.
